correction_to_previous_account: e2431c84e said Cluster.drawU runs only for groups left in the root SVEK image. That premise is incomplete. GroupMakerState.getImage builds a nested SVEK (GeneralImageBuilder over the group's children) for every autarkic group, and a non-autarkic group inside it stays a group there, so Cluster.drawU also runs inside the image: Java writes 'cluster Shed' from inside the autarkic Works image (cluster_entry_inside_autarkic). The comment and the drawing are one decision: a group drawn by Cluster.drawU gets the comment; a group replaced by a GroupMakerState image does not.
java_locations: svek/CucaDiagramSimplifierState.java#simplify/getOrdered: groups are visited deepest first; each autarkic group is replaced by GroupMakerState(diagram, g).getImage() (g.overrideImage), and the loop repeats until no group changes. A replaced group is a leaf to its parent.

abel/Entity.java#isAutarkic (lines 686-711): CONCURRENT_STATE is autarkic; otherwise every link of the diagram (diagram.getLinks(), note links included) must satisfy EntityUtils.isPureInnerLink3, and every direct leaf must have EntityPosition.NORMAL.
abel/EntityUtils.java#isPureInnerLink3 (lines 76-88): a link is pure inner when both or neither endpoint's parent container is inside the group.

abel/Entity.java#getEntityPosition (lines 324-345) -> EntityPosition.fromStereotype: entryPoint, exitPoint, inputPin, outputPin, expansionInput, expansionOutput (compared ignoring case) are non-NORMAL.

command/note/CommandFactoryNoteOnEntity: 'note right of X' creates a note entity in the current group plus a Link between note and X, so a root note on an inner leaf is a crossing link (cluster_root_note_on_inner).
svek/image/... GroupMakerState.getImage: a group with no children returns EntityImageState (an ordinary state box, no comment).
svek/Cluster.java#drawU (lines 309-311): writes 'cluster ' + group.getName() unless the name starts with ##.

statediagram/command/CommandLinkStateCommon.java (lines 75, 168-178) and StateDiagram.java#getHistorical(location, idShort)/getDeepHistory(location, idShort): 'X[H]'/'X[H*]' resolves X with quarkInContext(true, cleanId(X)), enters it as a STATE group (gotoGroup), creates *historical*X or *deephistory*X inside it, and leaves the group.
rust_locations: crates/rustuml-render/src/state.rs#java_state_group_is_autarkic (decision), autonomous_group_is_autarkic (links only, used for drawing), build_state_group_outcome, build_autonomous_composite, render_non_autarkic_root_clusters, emit_root_state_cluster.
causal_divergence: Drawing and comment use different predicates: build_state_group_outcome draws by autonomous_group_is_autarkic (links only), the comment by java_state_group_is_autarkic.

render_non_autarkic_root_clusters, the only path that lays out border points, refuses diagrams without a root-scope transition (Mill, Press, Sluice) and treats every composite as a cluster, including a childless one Java draws as a state box (Canal); diagrams it refuses fall through to the flat path, which cannot draw a cluster at all.
Neither SVEK path accepts notes, and java_state_group_is_autarkic ignores note links (Kiln).
The autonomous path refuses any non-NORMAL leaf, so a non-autarkic group with an entry point inside an autarkic image (Shed in Works) cannot be drawn.
The transition regex has no X[H] / X[H*] endpoint, so both Vault links are dropped.
invariant: For every state group, Rust draws a Cluster (with its comment) exactly when Java's CucaDiagramSimplifierState leaves it a group, at the root or inside an autarkic image, and draws an image or a state box (without comment) otherwise. The decision is java_state_group_is_autarkic everywhere.
planned_change: java_state_group_is_autarkic also counts attached-note links, using the note's declaring group (new serde-defaulted StateNote.parent) and its resolved anchor.
build_state_group_outcome chooses Cluster or Image with java_state_group_is_autarkic; emit_root_state_cluster writes the comment for every drawn cluster (## names excepted).

render_non_autarkic_root_clusters accepts any diagram whose child-bearing groups are all non-autarkic (no root-scope-transition or two-group requirement); childless groups are ordinary state nodes; attached notes join its SVEK layout as nodes with the line0/minlen-0 opale edge and are painted with emit_attached_svek_note.

Image regions accept a non-autarkic child group whose border points are laid out as cluster source/sink nodes, as the root path does, when that is reachable without new geometry; otherwise the case is recorded as residual.
The parser accepts X[H] and X[H*] endpoints: X is resolved and marked composite as gotoGroup does, and the endpoint is the history marker scoped to X.
